svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation ◆ The Duo apps are coming, says Apple ◆ Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web ◆ Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent ◆ After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years? ◆ Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory ◆
